guard: a signed-out user-auth refusal reaches a structured command as AUTH_REQUIRED, not as an unavailable dependency
why: The provider tags its signed-out failure and the connect path reads that tag; the suite signs a real user out against a live broker and reads ps --json. The suite imports the workspace build, so the mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: a signed-out provider failure is read as an unavailable dependency
mutations.expectRed: signed out: ps --json is one AUTH_REQUIRED envelope that names the login, exit 2
mutations.cell: signed out: ps --json is one AUTH_REQUIRED envelope that names the login, exit 2
